svg.text: a job launches its graph; stages read and write typed streams

text.tspan: channel (fine filter, wide_hz for the guard), pfb bank, resample
(rational, snapping), fft (CPU; GPU via wgpu behind feature gpu, shaders/;
notch_hz/edge_mask mark rows masked), measure (layer 1: occupied band,
SNR, burst gating with duty/bursts/burst_ms/period_ms, OOK chip rate from
run lengths, cyclostationary symbol rate, FSK/PSK order and tone spacing,
label incl. psk and ook; ±25 kHz DC mask beside a local capture centre),
nbfm/wfm/am/ssb demod to 48 kHz audio, squelch (auto floor + 6 dB) and
adjacent-channel guard, afsk + ax25 → aprs_decode, pocsag, rds, acars
(MSK), detect (runs of unmasked bins over the row median with a run-energy
floor that persist), mix (sums audio jobs on a 20 ms clock for listening),
the layer-4 chain: capture_in (replays a capture set, paced, looping) →
correlate (sync hits) → bit_view (run lengths, frame period, sync and CRC
candidates; CRC table ccitt, ibm, dnp, crc32, x25, kermit), denoise
(RNNoise via nnnoiseless), vad, catalogue scoring, synth/fixtures
(fsk/psk/ook families, RS41 frames, echo, snr, ppm impairments for modes
external_decode runs a program row's command over
stdio with IQ or demodulated audio (raw or wav
fifo) and parses json_lines, sbs, nmea, kiss,
text or multimon into events; adsb_decode
dfm09mod, m20mod); handler report at startup

svg.text: Pencilled in: where each planned piece lands (plan numbers from docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-18-zetasdr-plan-series.md, gists from TODO.md)

text.tspan: Web UI only. Plan 24 shipped the console theme, the rail,
riding ribbons, two-line rows and collapsible panes; still
pencilled in: a lane budget from the pixel height between
channels, mode picking by band through knowledge_lookup with a
search fallback, state-stream decoders such as ADS-B as one
NRZI/Manchester over the CRC table), thin Modbus RTU / DNP3 /
IEC-101/104 rows, operator-accepted signature write-back so the
next encounter is a layer-2 match. Open from 19.2: a real OOK
remote (433.882 MHz) not yet recovered end to end by the bits
An rtl_433 program row for ISM remotes and sensors (spec draft
46c9c46). Rows and small stages on the plan-17 frameworks: M17
as audio rows feeding transcribe; AIS (nmea parser, map), FLEX;
whole-span POCSAG/APRS as a watch with decode_on capture;
stereo wfm_demod with pilot level; DFM/M20 synthesised tests;
sink stage kinds for the standard feeds (APRS-IS, SBS/Beast,
AIS NMEA, PSK Reporter, WSPRnet, KISS TNC); a generic sink:
{kind, params} on the watch's detect node replacing the one-off
sondehub field (shorthand kept); fixes: a sink-bearing decoder
frozen as an operator graph, gated_stop cleared by a sink
Sonde rows before ACARS on a 12.5 kHz FSK box; a tone-pair
criterion and a per-device spur list for the detector (the B210
noise recording is pending the operator). Re-centring, the
median-referenced detector and the row-width slice shipped in
True block timestamps (HackRF drift bug) to unlock UTC-slotted
modes (FT8/FT4, WSPR) and TDMA (DMR, TETRA); a trunking
follower (P25, DMR Tier III, MPT1327) starting voice jobs from
control-channel events inside a pin; decoders that find their
own channels in a capture; wideband modes (DVB-T, DAB) on the
GPU FFT, parked behind the HackRF-first set.
Plan 25, the public release, is parked on its branch until its
fifos and snap/flatpak/AppImage install hints; the vocoder
install script and its legal note; layer 3 (a learned
classifier) stays an empty slot until layer-4 sessions produce
labelled captures; per-footprint theme layouts and a node-level
